name: WINNOW
source:
On a rural highway, two friends try to work through heartbreak. Then the radio falters. The stars multiply. A familiar face appears on the roadside, asking for a ride. The night becomes a test of trust – and survival.

[From [url=https://dorianatlas.itch.io/winnow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一条乡村公路上，两个朋友试图克服悲伤。然后收音机就不稳定了。星星倍增。路边出现了一张熟悉的面孔，正在叫车。夜晚成为对信任和生存的考验。

[来自[url=https://dorianatlas.itch.io/winnow]Itch.io[/url]]
